# @manfad99/ui — full LLM context

> Complete consumer guide for the Vue 3 admin UI kit: install, theming, package exports, DLCs, and component usage patterns.

This file is the large-context companion to `/llms.txt`. Prefer `llms.txt` unless you need implementation detail in one shot.

## Package

Name: `@manfad99/ui`
Stack: Vue 3.4+, UnoCSS 66+, radix-vue, HSL design tokens (Chrome 109+, no oklch)
Icons: UnoCSS + `@iconify-json/lucide` (`i-lucide-*` classes)
Font: Inter via `@fontsource/inter`

## Install

```bash
pnpm add @manfad99/ui vue @fontsource/inter
pnpm add -D unocss
```

App entry:

```ts
import '@manfad99/ui/ui.css'
import '@fontsource/inter/400.css'
import '@fontsource/inter/500.css'
import '@fontsource/inter/600.css'
import '@fontsource/inter/700.css'
```

UnoCSS:

```ts
import { defineConfig, presetWind3 } from 'unocss'
import { manfadUiContent, presetManfadUi } from '@manfad99/ui/preset'

export default defineConfig({
  content: {
    filesystem: manfadUiContent,
  },
  presets: [presetWind3(), ...presetManfadUi()],
})
```

Optional preset options: `presetManfadUi({ color: 'blue', radius: 0.5 })`.

Basic usage:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@manfad99/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <Button>Continue</Button>
</template>
```

## Package exports

| Export | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `@manfad99/ui` | Core components, composables, utilities |
| `@manfad99/ui/preset` | UnoCSS preset and content globs |
| `@manfad99/ui/ui.css` | Base component styles |
| `@manfad99/ui/chart` | Charts DLC — peer `@unovis/ts@1.6.7` + `@unovis/vue@1.6.7` |
| `@manfad99/ui/time-badge` | TimeBadge DLC — peer `@vueuse/core` |
| `@manfad99/ui/md-view` | Markdown viewer DLC — peer `markdown-it` |
| `@manfad99/ui/excel` | Excel import/export DLC — peer `xlsx` |

Core barrel does **not** re-export DLC surfaces. Install peers only when you import that subpath.

```ts
import { Button, DataTable } from '@manfad99/ui'
import { LineChart } from '@manfad99/ui/chart'
import { TimeBadge } from '@manfad99/ui/time-badge'
import { MdView } from '@manfad99/ui/md-view'
import { Excel, ExcelExport, ExcelImport } from '@manfad99/ui/excel'
```

## Theming

Default palette: Blue. Roles include primary, secondary, tertiary, rival, surfaces, forms, and sidebar (light/dark).

Rival is the opposing accent (for example red against blue). Use sparingly.

Override with HSL channels (no wrapping `hsl()`):

```css
:root {
  --primary: 221.2 83.2% 53.3%;
  --primary-foreground: 210 40% 98%;
  --rival: 0 72% 45%;
  --rival-foreground: 0 0% 98%;
}
```

`ThemeSwitcher` persists choices on `document.documentElement` as:
- `data-manfad-component-theme`
- `data-manfad-background-theme`

Palettes: Neutral, Blue, Green, Orange, Rose, Violet. White is background-only.

UnoCSS utilities: `bg-primary`, `bg-rival`, `text-rival-foreground`, etc. `Button` and `Badge` accept `variant="tertiary"` and `variant="rival"`.

## Charts DLC

```bash
pnpm add @unovis/ts@1.6.7 @unovis/vue@1.6.7
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { LineChart } from '@manfad99/ui/chart'

const data = [{ month: new Date(2025, 0, 1), kuching: 18420, miri: 12980 }]
const series = [
  { key: 'kuching', label: 'Kuching' },
  { key: 'miri', label: 'Miri' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <LineChart :data="data" x="month" :series="series" />
</template>
```

Also: `AreaChart`, `BarChart`, `DonutChart`, `ChartContainer`, `ChartLegend`, `ChartEmpty`.
Series colours: `--chart-1` … `--chart-5`.
`presetManfadUi()` is required so Unovis can fill `ChartContainer` height.
If you widen UnoCSS `content.pipeline.include` to plain `.ts`/`.js`, exclude `node_modules` or Unovis template-string CSS can break the build.

## Excel DLC

```bash
pnpm add xlsx
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { DataTable } from '@manfad99/ui'
import { Excel, ExcelExport, ExcelImport, type ExcelColumn } from '@manfad99/ui/excel'

const columns: ExcelColumn[] = [
  { key: 'id', label: 'ID' },
  { key: 'phone', label: 'Phone' },
  { key: 'workhour', label: 'Work hours', type: 'number' },
]
const rows = shallowRef([{ id: '001', phone: '012-3456789', workhour: 160 }])
</script>

<template>
  <Excel v-model:rows="rows" :columns="columns" filename="payroll">
    <ExcelExport text="Export Excel" format="xlsx" />
    <ExcelExport text="Export CSV" format="csv" />
    <ExcelImport text="Import" />
  </Excel>
  <DataTable :columns="columns" :rows="rows" row-key="id" />
</template>
```

Import replaces `rows`. Headers match label then key (normalized). Default cell type `string` (keeps MY phone leading zeros). Opt into `type: 'number'`.

## ModeToggle

Compound API — button cycles declarative modes:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { Mode, ModeToggle } from '@manfad99/ui'

const mode = shallowRef('docs')
</script>

<template>
  <ModeToggle v-model="mode" shortcut="d">
    <Mode value="docs">Document</Mode>
    <Mode value="playground">Playground</Mode>
    <Mode value="extra">Extra</Mode>
  </ModeToggle>
</template>
```

`Mode` is options-only (does not render UI). Label from default slot text or `label` prop.

## Timeline

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Timeline, TimelineItem } from '@manfad99/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <Timeline>
    <TimelineItem time="09:12" title="Order placed" icon="i-lucide-shopping-cart" state="done">
      Payment authorized.
    </TimelineItem>
    <TimelineItem time="09:40" title="Processing" state="done" />
    <TimelineItem time="14:05" title="Shipped" state="active" />
    <TimelineItem time="Est. Jul 24" title="Out for delivery" />
  </Timeline>

  <Timeline orientation="horizontal">
    <TimelineItem time="09:12" title="Placed" icon="i-lucide-shopping-cart" state="done" />
    <TimelineItem time="09:40" title="Processing" state="done" />
    <TimelineItem time="14:05" title="Shipped" state="active" />
    <TimelineItem time="Jul 24" title="Delivered" />
  </Timeline>
</template>
```

States: `done` | `active` | `upcoming`. Done/active icons are filled so the rail connects through markers.

## Confirmation

Mount once near the app root, then call `confirm()`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Confirmation, confirm } from '@manfad99/ui'

async function onDelete() {
  const ok = await confirm({
    title: 'Delete item?',
    description: 'This cannot be undone.',
  })
  if (ok) { /* … */ }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Confirmation />
</template>
```

## SelectionChips

Renders selected CheckboxTree leaves as expandable group rows:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { SelectionChips } from '@manfad99/ui'

const groups = [{
  key: 'items',
  label: 'Items',
  children: [
    { value: 'item_create', label: 'Create items' },
    { value: 'item_modify', label: 'Modify items' },
  ],
}]
const values = ['item_create', 'item_modify']
</script>

<template>
  <SelectionChips :groups="groups" :values="values" />
</template>
```

## CodeBlock

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CodeBlock } from '@manfad99/ui'
const content = `// comment\nroot.dataset.manfadComponentTheme = 'blue'\n`
</script>

<template>
  <CodeBlock :content="content" />
</template>
```

## SignatureDialog

```vue
<SignatureDialog
  v-model:open="open"
  filename="customer-signature.png"
  @save="signatureUrl = $event"
/>
```

On Save, downloads a PNG unless `:download="false"`, and emits the data URL.

## SidebarSwitcher

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { SidebarSwitcher } from '@manfad99/ui'

const context = shallowRef('docs')
const items = [
  { value: 'docs', label: 'Document' },
  { value: 'playground', label: 'Playground' },
  { value: 'extra', label: 'Extra' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <SidebarSwitcher
    v-model="context"
    title="@manfad99/ui"
    icon="i-lucide-layers"
    :items="items"
  />
</template>
```

## Component catalog (core)

Primitive: Accordion, Badge, Button, Calendar, Card, Checkbox, Dialog, Dropdown, Hover, Image, Input, List, ModeToggle, Popover, Progress, RadioGroup, Row, ScrollArea, Select, Skeleton, Spinner, Switch, Table, Tabs, Textarea, Toast, Toggle, Wheel.

Forms: Autocomplete, CheckboxTree, Choice, ChoiceCard, DatePicker, DateFilter, FormField, IconInput, InputClear, MonthPicker, NumberInput, Stepper, TimePicker, Timetable.

Layout: AppShell, PaneContainer, Sidebar (+ SidebarSwitcher), ThemePalette, ThemeSwitcher.

Feedback: Confirmation / AlertDialog, Empty, ErrorPage, UnauthorizedPage, NoPermissionPage, LoadingDialog, PageLoading.

Content: Attachment, BigCalendar, CodeBlock, Filter, Gallery, SelectionChips, SignaturePad / SignatureDialog, Timeline.

Tables: CheckTable, CollapsibleTable, DataTable, Expandable, GroupedTable (editable patterns in playground).

## Component catalog (DLC / Extra)

Charts (`@manfad99/ui/chart`): AreaChart, BarChart, DonutChart, LineChart.
Add-ons: Excel (`@manfad99/ui/excel`), MdView (`@manfad99/ui/md-view`), TimeBadge (`@manfad99/ui/time-badge`).

## Conventions for AI assistants

1. Import from `@manfad99/ui` for core; never assume charts/excel/md-view/time-badge are on the root barrel.
2. Use `<script setup lang="ts">` and `shallowRef` when deep reactivity is unnecessary.
3. Style with UnoCSS utility classes and semantic tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`), not hardcoded greys when a token exists.
4. Prefer existing components (Dialog, Confirmation, Empty, DataTable) over reinventing admin chrome.
5. Icons: pass UnoCSS icon classes (`i-lucide-search`), not SVG blobs, unless the component API requires otherwise.
6. Target Chrome 109+: HSL CSS variables only — do not introduce oklch in consumer overrides meant to match this kit.
